_doc: Each entry: {id, quote, area, displayName (string or null=anonymous), verified (bool), date}. Site renders entries in order. Empty array shows a 'be the first' message.
_workflow: 1. Resident submits via the sign-up form (Take Action section). 2. Submission lands in your form-backend dashboard (Tally / Formspree / etc) plus your inbox. 3. You verify their address (council tax bill, etc) and that they consent to publication. 4. Add an entry below, commit, push — GitHub Action redeploys within ~60s.
